definitions.explanation: Secret or covert efforts to influence a situation, negotiation, or outcome without others knowing. Carries a negative connotation, implying underhanded or manipulative tactics.

examples.japanese: {裏工作|うらこうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{裏工作|うらこうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are suspicions of backroom dealings before the election.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Always carries a negative connotation — the actions described are secretive and often unethical or illegal. Commonly appears in political and business news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏工作|うらこうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to engage in backroom dealings)
- {裏工作|うらこうさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧ (backroom dealings are exposed)
- {裏工作|うらこうさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to resort to underhanded tactics)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根回|ねまわ}し→根回し：07727_nemawashi⟧: laying the groundwork — neutral or positive, describes legitimate behind-the-scenes consensus building
